XSS via innerHTML

bugs.explanation: Setting `innerHTML` with user-provided data allows XSS — if `name` contains `<script>` or `onerror=` attributes, it executes malicious code. Always use `textContent` for text, or create DOM elements manually with `createElement`/`textContent`.

title: SQL Injection Analog (Query Building)

bugs.fix:
// Use parameterized queries with your database driver:
// db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [userId])
bugs.explanation: Template literal interpolation directly embeds user input into a SQL query, enabling SQL injection. If `userId` is `'1 OR 1=1'`, the query returns all users. Always use parameterized (prepared) statements provided by your database driver.

title: CORS Headers

bugs.explanation: Reflecting `req.headers.origin` back as the `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` value (or using `'*'` with credentials) allows any origin to make credentialed cross-origin requests. Whitelist specific trusted origins explicitly.

title: Timing Attack in Comparison

bugs.explanation: String equality `===` short-circuits on the first unequal character, creating a timing side channel. An attacker can determine correct characters by measuring response time. Use a constant-time comparison that always checks every character.
